During the event, there will be 6 difficulty levels available: Normal, Advancing, Hard, Menacing, Fearless and Dire. On each difficulty, players will face powerful foes on 3 separate battlefields.

Exalted Ones

The characters Travelers used to clear Dire Difficulty and complete the Perilous Objective will receive "Eminence" and "Enduring Eminence" respectively. A single character can only have either of these status and receiving "Enduring Eminence" will replace the existing "Eminence."
The 16 characters with the most Eminence on the server will become the new Exalted Ones and grant powerful combat boons to other Travelers. The initial list of Exalted Ones will be updated 2 hours at 12:00 PM (GMT+8) after Stygian Onslaught challenges unlock and the information will be regularly updated every day at 04:00 AM (GMT+8)
When other Travelers challenge Fearless Difficulty or below with Exalted Ones, the "Eminent Boon" will become active. These characters will have their <color=#ffe14b>Max HP, ATK and DEF increased by 20%</color> during the challenge.
Co-Op Mode

Players can invite teammates to take part in Co-Op challenges while in Co-Op Mode.
When multiple players enter the challenge, the opponents' combat power will change to that of the corresponding Co-Op difficulty, and will not continue to change based on the number of players participating in the challenge.
Co-Op challenge results will be recorded separately, and players can check these records at any time. However, only Single-Player Mode challenge records can be displayed to friends.
Battle Preparation
<color=#ffffff>Party Setup</color>
On the Party Setup Menu, Travelers can choose the characters for the 3 different Battlefields. Depending on the challenge difficulty, same character may or may not be allowed.
In the Single-Player Mode and up to Hard Difficulty in Co-Op Mode, players always adjust the party lineup before each battle in the Battle Preparation Interface.

<color=#ffffff73>However, from Menacing Difficulty onwards in Co-Op Mode, players will have to choose their characters after initiating the Co-Op challenge and after the leader begins the battle, all players won't be able to adjust their lineup, weapons and artifacts during the challenge.</color>

<color=#ffffff73>If players change their lineup for a specific enemy or weapons or artifacts for a character, only the battlefield specific to that enemy will be reset and players may override their record upon completion.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Additionally, if a character is sharing a weapon or artifact with a different character who is used in a different Battlefield, then the challenge record for said Battlefield must be reset to save the new record.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Domain of Blessing</color>

Before starting the challenge, players can select their preferred Domain of Blessings for rewards and the choice can be freely switched during the Disturbance Outbreak.
In Co-Op Mode, only the leader is allowed to choose the Domain of Blessing.
Disturbance Outbreak

In the 10 days after the Stygian Onslaught challenge is available, the Ley Line Disturbance will be in an "Outbreak" state.
When players with Adventure Rank 45 and above challenge stages at "Hard" difficulty or higher, they can consume resin to revitalize special disturbance-affected Ley Line Blossoms and obtain rewards from their chosen Domain of Blessing.
When they consume resin in the aforementioned method, they can accumulate Dire Prestige. When players accumulate 120 Dire Prestige and 1,200 Dire Prestige, they can obtain a Phase Reward and Dire Commendation, respectively. The Phase Reward can be obtained multiple times during the event.

If it has taken more Lunar Reaction DMG when it exits the Gloomveiled state, its Elemental Type will change to Elementless, and it <color=#ffe14b>will not gain any Elemental DMG Immunity or Elemental Effects</color> .
<color=#ffffff>Battle-Hardened Lightkeeper: Mourning Echoes</color>

customize.name: Sigurd
customize.desc: A valiant warrior who resisted the dark calamity in ancient days. Though his life's spark has been extinguished, his unbending will has yet to fade, and those who swore to become hunters of the Wild Hunt continue his endless battle even today. The dark abyss's corrosion has seeped into his marrow, causing him to lose his way, but the desire to defend hearth and home will surely reignite, reawakening him to continue a bitter, eternal battle.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color> has an advantage
<color=#ffd780>Wandering Lament</color>
Begins the battle in the "Roaming" state and when its HP is completely depleted, it will enter the "Wild Hunt" state.
<color=#ffd780>Grief-Stricken</color>
When in the Wild Hunt state, even if its HP is reduced to zero, it will regain its HP up to its maximum after a period of time.
Draining <color=#ffe14b>its HP completely or using Skills enhanced by Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color> will send it into a brief Grief-Stricken state. A certain ratio of the DMG dealt to it while in this state will be converted to reduce its Max HP. The ratio will be increased if the party has <color=#ffe14b>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color> .
<color=#ffd780>Exiles Surge</color>
When in the Wild Hunt state, Wilderness Exiles will appear periodically. The Wilderness Exiles' Max HP is increased, and the ratio at which the foe's Max HP is restored upon harvesting the exiles is higher.
If the player fails to defeat all of these exiles within a certain period of time, the enemy will perform a harvest, dealing massive AoE DMG and slaughtering the Wilderness Exiles, restoring its own Max HP based on the remaining Max HP of the exiles.
<color=#ffffff>Veteran Frost Operative: Bloodsoaked Blade</color>

customize.name: Frost Operative
customize.desc:
An elite agent among the Fatui.

Selected while still children, they can only become an "Operative" after many long years of training and teaching, after countless rounds have winnowed the field. They are the most outstanding soldiers among the Fatui, with extraordinary skill and unswerving loyalty.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff>Bond of Life Characters</color> have an advantage
<color=#ffffff>Shield Characters</color> have an advantage
<color=#ffd780>Rapid Kill</color>
Consumes a certain percentage of HP in combat to use Hunt Down: When it hits a character, it restores a certain percentage of the enemy's HP and attaches a Bond of Life to the character hit.
While Bond of Life is active, the affected character will take continuous DMG. Characters with Bond of Life attached will take increased DMG from this attack.
<color=#ffd780>Bloody Pursuit</color>
The Veteran Frost Operative possesses greater interruption capabilities and interruption resistance.
When preparing to use Hunt Down, it will enter the Bloody Pursuit state, creating a Shield to protect itself.
While the Shield is active, it will <color=#ffe14b>continuously attach Bonds of Life to all characters</color> . After the Shield is broken, the Veteran Frost Operative will take immense DMG.
Stygian Onslaught: Terrorshock Blitz
<color=#ffffff73>Duration:</color> <color=#ffffff73>September 17, 2025 10:00 ~ October 21, 2025 03:59 (Server Time)</color>
<color=#ffffff>Aeonblight Drake: Annihilation Configuration</color>

customize.name: Aeonblight Drake
customize.desc:
This dragon-shaped combat machine is a being that inspires fear, much like the lord who once ruled these vast lands.

It is said that the now-destroyed realm once sought forbidden knowledge and attempted to create perpetual-motion machines that could match or even surpass primordial lifeforms. This mysterious, tireless mechanical monstrosity seems to be proof that they did indeed reach heights that mortals should never have attained.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff>Multi Elemental DMG</color> has an advantage
<color=#ffffff>Single Elemental DMG</color> has a disadvantage
<color=#ffd780>Emergency Countermeasures</color>
Every time DMG equaling a certain percentage of Aeonblight Drake's HP is taken, a torrent of energy will be unleashed.
It will change form in response to the type of Elemental DMG it has suffered the most from during that period, <color=#ffe14b>significantly increasing its Elemental RES to that Element</color> .
<color=#ffd780>Multi-Combat Mechanics</color>
The combat will start while it is in the ground-attack state.
If it fails to release a torrent of energy for a long time, it will switch to the aerial-attack state.
<color=#ffd780>Core Armor Compartment</color>
Aeonblight Drake's cores are now protected.
It will no longer be paralyzed when they are attacked, nor will its Elemental RES boost be removed.
<color=#ffffff>Battle-Scarred Rock Crab: One Million Blasts</color>

customize.name: Crab Tsar
customize.desc: Its mind infected by ancient moonlight, this ruler of crabs was plunged for a time into delirium and madness. But just as it was about to unleash its might, it suffered a crushing defeat at the hands of a thief who broke into its court, rendering it more agreeable. Even so, this crustacean suzerain yet yearns to clash pincers with strong foes, longing to triumph over opponents worthy of its full might.

customize.text:
<color=#99ff88>Bloom Reaction</color> has an advantage
<color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> has a disadvantage
<color=#ffd780>Stoneborne Seeds</color>
In battle, Stoneborne Seeds will be scattered across the battlefield before exploding after a short delay.
If these seeds take <color=#99ff88>Bloom</color> <color=#ffe14b>,</color> <color=#99ff88>Hyperbloom</color> <color=#ffe14b>,</color> <color=#c0fcbe>Lunar-Bloom</color> <color=#ffe14b>, or</color> <color=#99ff88>Burgeon DMG</color> before they explode, they will undergo conversion and turn their attacks toward the Rock Crab instead, dealing DMG based on the total amount of DMG the Stoneborne Seeds received.
<color=#ffd780>Flammable Hermit</color>
Stoneborne Seeds will violently explode after taking <color=#ff9999>Pyro DMG</color> , knocking characters back and dealing massive DMG.
<color=#ffd780>Almighty Tsarly Bombardment</color>
The Rock Crab will leap into the air after the battle begins and enter a short period of charging up.
After charging, it will unleash a powerful attack, <color=#ffe14b>immediately defeating your current active character</color> and greatly increasing its own All RES.
While charging, the Rock Crab will deploy a Ward, which can be broken if <color=#ffe14b>a certain amount of Stoneborne Seeds are converted</color> .
Breaking its Ward will interrupt the Rock Crab's charging and leave it paralyzed.
<color=#ffffff>Battle-Hardened Fireblade Shock Trooper: Forlorn Hope</color>

customize.name: Oprichniki Fireblade Shock Trooper
customize.desc:
An elite officer of the Fatui Oprichniki who specializes in close combat using a giant blade.
Whether it be in the war against the dark calamity or against those ignoramuses who dare stand against the Tsaritsa's ideals, those who breach at the tip of the spear suffer the greatest casualties. As such, those who survive multiple battles are naturally the elite of the elite. There will always be those willing to become the fire and sword of the empire, just as there will always be those who chafe against the injustice of fate and the inequity of the Old World.

customize.text:
<color=#ffacff>Electro-Charged Reaction</color> has an advantage
<color=#ffacff>Electro</color> has an advantage
<color=#ffd780>Multi-Shield</color>
When Fireblade Shock Trooper prepares to activate Thundering Suite, a Multi-Shield will be deployed. During the preparation, <color=#ffe14b>focus on breaking the triple-layer Experimental Multi-Shield</color> to prevent the activation.
The Shield will periodically repair itself.
<color=#ffacff>Electro-Charged</color> and <color=#d3c0ff>Lunar-Charged DMG</color> are more effective at destroying the Shield.
Additional Elemental Orbs will be generated for each layer of the Shield that is destroyed.
<color=#ffd780>Thundering Barrage</color>
When Thundering Suite is activated, it will deal <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> over a large AoE and then unleash continuous <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> attacks.
If the suite's activation is successfully prevented, the opponent's <color=#ffacff>Electro RES</color> <color=#ffe14b>will be greatly decreased</color> .
<color=#ffd780>Emergency Power Surge</color>
The Experimental Multi-Shield increases All RES except <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> , and its self-repairing abilities are boosted.
After taking <color=#ffacff>Electro-Charged</color> and <color=#d3c0ff>Lunar-Charged DMG</color> , its rate of self-repair will be greatly reduced.
Once activated, the DMG dealt by Thundering Suite, as well as its duration is greatly increased.

<color=#ffffff>Tenebrous Papilla: Shadow Void Transfiguration</color>

customize.name: Tenebrous Papilla: Type I
customize.desc:
Abyssal creatures with plant-like forms that have descended from a deep, dark, unfathomable, contorted otherworld.
These twisted monstrosities are capable of infiltrating deep down into the bowels of the earth, extracting memories to imitate and manipulate. Through this process of distorting the past's memories into more abstruse and sordid forms, they gradually draw closer to Irminsul's core, threatening to undermine its very existence.
Some say that these aberrations work constantly to corrupt the many colors of light, leaving only pitch-black information in their stead. Such a hypothesis seems to be confirmed by the branches they extend outward, as if to pierce the void itself...

customize.text:
<color=#ece5d8>High-frequency Elemental DMG</color> has an advantage
<color=#ece5d8>Nightsoul-aligned DMG</color> has an advantage
<color=#ffd780>Tenebrous Mimesis</color>
Tenebrous Papilla can warp itself and transform into powerful enemies.
<color=#ffd780>Attrition Assault</color>
Certain attacks will inflict "Attrition".
"Attrition" is a stackable state which causes the active party member to lose HP after a certain amount of time.
<color=#ffd780>Shadow Void Aegis</color>
While initiating attacks, Tenebrous Papilla will deploy a Void Ward and performing <color=#ffe14b>a certain number of Elemental attacks</color> can break it.
After the Void Ward is broken, Tenebrous Papilla will receive a single instance of DMG based on all the DMG absorbed during the Ward Phase and it will enter a weakened state for an extended period of time.
<color=#ffe14b>Nightsoul-aligned Elemental attacks</color> are the most effective way of breaking the Void Ward and will increase the single instance DMG dealt when it is broken.
After the weakened state ends, it will attempt to re-deploy its Void Ward.
<color=#ffd780>Hatefully Beseech the Dark</color>
If the Void Ward is unbroken for too long, Tenebrous Papilla will initiate Hateful Beseech the Dark and enter a charging state. If the Void Ward continues to remain unbroken, it will unleash Wrathful Dark Bombardment and <color=#ffe14b>immediately defeat the current active character</color> .
<color=#ffffff>Battle-Hardened Tent Tortoise: Thunderous Aegis</color>

customize.name: Cocijo
customize.desc: Spirit Sent From Clouds Above

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff>Low-frequency DMG</color> has an advantage
<color=#ffffff>High-frequency DMG</color> has a disadvantage
<color=#ffd780>Thunderthorn Ward</color>
After taking a <color=#ffe14b>certain number of attacks</color> within a small time period, it will deploy a Thunderthorn Ward.
While the Ward is active, DMG received will be reflected to nearby characters.
The Ward can be broken by using Elemental Reactions to <color=#ffe14b>drain the Ward of</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> .
<color=#ffd780>Thunderous Attrition</color>
Every time the enemy is attacked, it progresses towards deploying a Thunderthorn Ward by a greater amount, but the progress also decreases gradually over time.
Elemental requirements for breaking the Thunderthorn Ward are greatly increased.
Note: The enemy is <color=#ffe14b>not immune</color> to <color=#99ffff>freeze</color> .
<color=#ffffff>Battle-Hardened Pipilpan Idol: Hundred Deceptions</color>

customize.name: The Last Survivor of Tenochtzitoc
customize.desc: Actor: Papar

customize.text:
<color=#ffacff>Electro-Charged Reaction</color> has an advantage
<color=#ffffff>Shields</color> have an advantage
<color=#ffd780>Hat Show</color>
During the battle, the entity will create multiple hats and hide within one of them. Then, it will rapidly switch the positions of these hats.
After a certain number of switches, if <color=#ffe14b>the hat that conceals the entity takes</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro-Charged</color> <color=#ffe14b>or</color> <color=#d3c0ff>Lunar-Charged DMG</color> , it will temporarily halt all hat-swapping actions.
When a certain amount of DMG is dealt to <color=#ffe14b>the hat concealing the entity</color> , all hats will be broken causing the entity to reveal itself, receive a single instance of DMG based on the DMG received during the Hat Show and temporarily enter a weakened state.
<color=#ffacff>Electro-Charged</color> <color=#ffe14b>or</color> <color=#d3c0ff>Lunar-Charged</color> reactions are the most effective way to break the hat.
The single instance DMG received by the entity will increase based on the <color=#80c0ff>Hydro DMG</color> <color=#ffe14b>,</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> <color=#ffe14b>,</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro-Charged DMG</color> <color=#ffe14b>, or</color> <color=#d3c0ff>Lunar-Charged DMG</color> the hat has taken.
<color=#ffd780>Hat Denial</color>
The entity will unleash a powerful attack: Hat Denial.
It will continuously hurl hats that deal <color=#ffacff>high Electro DMG</color> and have <color=#ffe14b>powerful interruption capabilities</color> .

<color=#ffffff>Hydro Tulpa: Turbulent Vortex</color>

customize.name: Hydro Tulpa
customize.desc: A humanoid monster formed from the agglomeration of water.

customize.text:
<color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> has an advantage
<color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> has a disadvantage
<color=#ffd780>Twin Half-Tulpas</color>
2 <color=#ffd680>Half-Tulpas</color> will emerge during the challenge at intervals.
If the <color=#ffd680>Half-Tulpas</color> are not destroyed in time, Hydro Tulpa will absorb them to <color=#ffe14b>heal a large amount of HP and enhance its ATK</color> .
<color=#99ffff>Freeze</color> is the most effective reaction to interrupt the absorption.
<color=#ffd780>Torrential Flurry</color>
Hydro Tulpa will deploy a Ward and enter a charging state, resetting all party members' Elemental Skill and Burst CDs and restoring Elemental Energy, Fighting Spirit, and Serpent's Subtlety.
If the Ward is not broken before it finishes charging up, it will unleash <color=#ffd680>Torrential Flurry</color> and <color=#ffe14b>immediately defeat the current active character</color> .
<color=#ffffff>Lava Dragon Statue: Blazing Flame</color>

customize.name: Lava Dragon Statue
customize.desc:
A monster that can continuously generate heat to sustain its activities.
Legends say these monsters with lava at their cores are the products of a distinct line of research to the Source Mechanisms that followed them — research into whether the primal flame could be used to create a new race based on humans. This research undoubtedly failed, for once the reaver arrived with their throne from beyond the skies, all that the primal flame could birth were hollow shells whose nominal lifeforce granted them no more consciousness than a stone.

customize.text:
<color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> and <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> have an advantage
<color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> and <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> have a disadvantage
<color=#ffd780>Dual Pyroclast</color>
At the start of combat, the Lava Dragon Statue will take the Geohuman form, which <color=#ffffff73>possesses</color> <color=#ffe14b>high Elemental and Physical RES</color> .
After taking a certain number of <color=#ff9999>Pyro DMG</color> instances, it will enter its Molten Dragon form, in which <color=#ffe14b>all Elemental and Physical RES apart from Pyro RES is greatly reduced</color> .
As it takes further instances of <color=#ff9999>Pyro DMG</color> , it will progressively take additional DMG. If it reaches a certain number of additional <color=#ff9999>Pyro DMG</color> instances, it will enter Overburn and <color=#ffe14b>become immobilized</color> .
During the Overburn state, its <color=#ffe14b>all Elemental and Physical RES is further decreased</color> and after some time has passed, it will return to its Geohuman form.
<color=#ffd780>Cooldown Effect</color>
After taking <color=#80c0ff>Hydro DMG</color> or <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> , it will gradually return to its Geohuman form.
<color=#ffd780>Roiling Agglomeration</color>
The Lava Dragon Statue's <color=#ffe14b>All RES is further increased</color> and require higher number of <color=#ff9999>Pyro DMG</color> instances to change its form.
<color=#ffffff>Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device - Obliterator Panoply</color>

customize.name: Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device
customize.desc:
A domination mechanism from the ancient ruins.
In ancient times, to oversee the operation of their mega-cities, a mighty race vested part of their power into a form of phlogiston-engineered intelligence. Driven by their mission, and by means of various other mechanisms, the machines upon which it was bestowed once controlled the functioning of myriad cities across the land. Now, long after their ancient civilization's fall through wars with an emerging race, these once-wise contraptions retain only the most basic of commands.

customize.text:
<color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> has an advantage
<color=#ffd780>Preemptive Sweeper Mode</color>
At the start of combat, Overseer Device will immediately enter Sweeper Mode, <color=#ffe14b>greatly increasing all Elemental and Physical RES</color> .
While performing its attacks, it will <color=#ffe14b>generate Flow Momentum</color> . The higher it is, the faster it will rotate and the higher DMG it will deal.
After taking <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> , it will lose Flow Momentum and below a certain value, it will stop rotating and attacking, and its <color=#ffe14b>all Elemental and Physical RES will be greatly decreased</color> while <color=#99ffff>Cryo RES</color> will be <color=#ffe14b>decreased even further</color> .
Each time it enters Sweeper Mode, it will generate additional Elemental Orbs the first time its rotating attacks are stopped.
<color=#ffd780>Forced Counterstrike Mode</color>
If an active character enters and maintains <color=#ffe14b>Nightsoul's Blessing state</color> for a certain time, Overseer Device will enter Forced Counterstrike Mode.
During this mode, it will attack with powerful tracking rays and its <color=#ffe14b>all Elemental and Physical RES will be decreased</color> .
After taking a certain number of <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> instances while in this state, it will cease attacking, and its <color=#ffe14b>all Elemental and Physical RES will be further decreased</color> .
<color=#ffd780>Damage-Resistant Structure</color>
The Overseer Devce's <color=#ffe14b>All RES is further increased</color> and it loses less Flow Momentum when taking <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> instances. It will also lose less RES when it's in the <color=#ffd780>Forced Counterstrike Mode</color> .
